messages:
Alex (Product): Quick alignment thread: we need to finalize scope for the enterprise audit sprint. Customer asks: BYOK-bound exports + configurable retention lanes.
Dee (Security): Must classify events: auth/keystore ops = full preserve; model traces = sampled. Sampling must be deterministic and reproducible.
Rico (Eng-Infra): Hash-based sampling per request_id is simplest and reproducible. Will add `audit_policy` to tenant config: {auth:full,trace:10%,meta:1%}. Index on request_id needed for fast exports. Estimate: 1 sprint.
Taylor (Solutions): Sales flagged auditor requirement: signed export bundles with manifest + verification steps. Also need rotation scenario doc (what happens if customer rotates KEK).
Mina (Legal): I'll draft pilot terms: default 90-day retention, paid extensions, deterministic sampling disclosure, export SLA, and key-rotation responsibilities in onboarding.
InfraBot: Created TASK-7120: "audit-export-manifest-spec" assigned to @Rico.
Dee (Security): Security spec: envelope encrypt export files with a data key, wrap with tenant KEK (BYOK), include `sampling_seed`, `manifest_version`, and `platform_signature` fields. Recommend AES-256-GCM + ED25519 for signatures.
Alex (Product): Proposed pilot acceptance: tenant policy API + console UI; signed export + verification guide; BYOK export flow + rotation runbook; retention tiers (30/90/365); live auditor walkthrough with 2 pilots.
Rico (Eng-Infra): Draft manifest (example):
request_id: req_42
tenant: acme
time_range: 2026-04-01T00:00Z/2026-04-02T00:00Z
sampling_policy: trace:10%,meta:1%
sampling_seed: abc123
wrapped_key: base64(...)
manifest_hmac: hex(...)
files: ["trace-req_42.ndjson.gz"]

Taylor (Solutions): I'll prepare demo script and onboarding checklist.
Mina (Legal): Once I share contract language, product can check wording with sales.
Alex (Product): Action items: Rico -> TASK-7120 + infra estimate; Dee -> security spec; Mina -> contract addendum; Taylor -> demo checklist. Sync EOD Wednesday. If blockers arise, tag me here.
